subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate tests as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok rotation failure?
rationale: External PRs normally need after-fix real behavior proof, but the contributor plausibly explains that the exact code-less xAI error only occurs during provider-side snapshot/key rotation and cannot be induced on demand without exercising a different error path.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Record a maintainer proof override for this provider-side trigger, then re-review the rebased exact head and merge if checks remain green.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the proof gate open until a future xAI rotation produces redacted gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds on this branch.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Record a maintainer proof override for this provider-side trigger, then re-review the rebased exact head and merge if checks remain green.
